MRI Safety Information
The Vega Transcatheter Valve is MR Conditional. Patients with this device can be scanned at ≤ 3 T when all of the following conditions are met.
General conditions:
- Spatial field gradient: ≤ 2500 gauss/cm (25 T/m).
- Scan in Normal Operating Mode.
- Any transmit coil may be used.
- Use CP mode only (circularly polarized RF excitation).
- B1+rms <= 1 μT.
- WB-SAR ≤ 0.4 W/kg.
- Maximum Head SAR 0.1 W/kg.
- Limit total active scanning to 10 min.
Testing used a maximum gradient amplitude of 40 mT/m.
